facts.fact: The Cable Consortium of Liberia offers co-location in its Monrovia landing facility (racks of 2-10U at 1 kW, 24U at 3 kW and 42U at 5 kW, with UPS and generator power); the page gives no date, so the 2025-04-29 publication date is used, and it claims no Tier certification.
